document.about: US EPA AP-42, Chapter 2.4, municipal solid waste landfills (2024, public domain). Its tables mark row labels with note letters (a to f), set as smaller raised glyphs right against the word.

notes: A plain read of the text layer joins the letter to the word, Acrylonitrilea. A raised mark after a word is a note's; raised text that belongs to the word (a unit's power, an ordinal, a formula's index) stays in it.
